run_generate_asm_lcov: run the script with a callgrind folder and build folder to generate LCOV coverage output for assembly files
create_is_asm_check: create a function that checks whether a line of assembly source code should be considered an instruction
merge_callgrind_annotate: merge callgrind_annotate output from multiple callgrind files using assembly source files as input
parse_callgrind_data: parse annotated execution flow data from callgrind_annotate and update per-line execution counts for a source file
generate_lcov_output: generate LCOV coverage format output from a dictionary of filenames and their assembly instruction execution counts
